title: Structure of the simultaneous parameter-root algebra over a strict local ring
statement:
Let $R$ be a strictly henselian regular Noetherian local ring, with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $k$ [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology, def-weil-regular-scheme, def-weil-residue-field]. Let $t_1,\ldots,t_r\in\mathfrak m$, for $r\geq0$, extend to a regular system of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters]. Let $n\geq1$ be invertible in $R$, and let $\zeta\in R^\times$ satisfy $\zeta^n=1$ and $1-\zeta^a\in R^\times$ for $1\leq a<n$. Put
$$B=R[x_1,\ldots,x_r]/(x_1^n-t_1,\ldots,x_r^n-t_r),\qquad f=\prod_i t_i,$$
using multivariate polynomial rings [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Then $B$ is a strictly henselian regular local domain, its residue field map $k\to B/\mathfrak m_B$ is an isomorphism, and it is free as an $R$-module on $x^a=\prod_i x_i^{a_i}$ with $0\leq a_i<n$ (that is, every element of $B$ has a unique $R$-linear expansion in those monomials). In particular $R\to B$ is injective. Write $K=\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ and $E=\operatorname{Frac}(B)$ [def-pc-field-extension]. The extension $E/K$ is finite Galois (finite and separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], with the minimal polynomial of each element splitting into linear factors over $E$), has degree $n^r$, and the homomorphism
$$(\mathbf Z/n\mathbf Z)^r\longrightarrow\operatorname{Aut}_K(E),\qquad h(x_i)=\zeta^{h_i}x_i,$$
is an isomorphism. These rotations preserve $B$. The map $\operatorname{Spec}B[1/f]\to\operatorname{Spec}R[1/f]$ is finite etale [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-ring-localization-away, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Empty products are $1$; when $r=0$ one has $B=R$, $E=K$ and the trivial group.
